title: Banks Act Circular C7/2014 — External auditors of newly acquired or established entities
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). External auditors of newly acquired or established entities.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). External auditors of newly acquired or established entities.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: External auditors of newly acquired or established entities. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
